metadata.name: DisputeResolution
metadata.description: The purpose of this API is to resolve the transaction dispute.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Card Holder's Account number. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 8000000000000037 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: TransactionID
request_fields.description: Transaction Number for transaction being posted. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 23654789

request_fields.name: DisputeAction
request_fields.description: Action to be performed on Dispute Transaction. Valid Values: All dispute Actions mentioned in the appendix section 'Dispute Actions’ Except 0 and 9 Example: 2 - Resolve in favor of Cardholder

request_fields.name: DisputeReason
request_fields.description: Reason through which Dispute resolution needs to take place. Valid Values: Please refer appendix section 'Dispute Reason'. Example: 7 - Duplicate Processing

request_fields.name: DisputeResolveAmount
request_fields.description: Amount  for which Dispute need to resolve. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XX.XX Example: 10.50

request_fields.name: MemoReason
request_fields.description: Reason of Memo Text. Valid Values: 0-9, A-Z Example: Disputed Transaction Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: MemoText
request_fields.description: Text of the Memo. Valid Values:0-9, a-z, special characters Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: New Transaction posted. Allowable Values: 1800

request_fields.name: CaseID
request_fields.description: Case which is generated against the Dispute request. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXX Example:9856198

request_fields.name: ChargebackMemo
request_fields.description: Note which is to be sent to Association Valid Values: 0-9,A-Z Example:Documents verified.

request_fields.name: FraudLabel
request_fields.description: Mark Transaction as Fruadulent/NonFraudulent. Valid Value: 0 and 1 Example: 1- Fraudulent 0- Non-Fraudulent Condition: Mandatory if the Feedzai system is active for that product but optional if the product is not enrolled in Feedzai.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: DisputeAmount
children.description: The amount for which the Dispute is raised on the Transaction. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 20.00

children.name: DisputeTranID
children.description: Disputed Transaction ID. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXX Example:9856198

children.name: CaseID
children.description: ID which is generated against the Dispute  request. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXX Example:9856198

children.name: FraudTypeCode
children.description: Defines the Fraud Type Code prescribed for SAFE Reporting to Mastercard in the SAFE Reporting Guide. Valid Values:Refer Appendix section Fraud Type Code Example: 06 Allowable Values: 5

children.name: SubFraudTypeCode
children.description: Defines the Sub Fraud Type Code prescribed for SAFE Reporting to Mastercard in the SAFE Reporting Guide Valid Values:Refer Appendix section Sub Fraud Type Code Example: K Allowable Values: 5
